headline: Linn Mercy Post Goes Dark; Stonecradle Line Thins
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Linn Mercy no longer stands wholly Colonial: one strongpoint has gone to no-man's-land, cutting the Colonial count from eleven to ten, and no Warden banner has reappeared. Lathair still draws the heaviest traffic there, with thirteen ownership entries over the day. Stonecradle has resumed sharp movement, logging five base events in the latest two hours; the line now reads six Colonial posts, two Warden posts, and one destroyed point, with casualties heavy on both sides. Stlican Shelf has narrowed from a six-three Warden margin to five-four, the Colonials gaining a post. Weathered Expanse remains the map's busiest ledger at nineteen daily entries and is still split five Wardens to four Colonials, the action clustered at Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Mooring County holds all twelve posts for the Wardens again after eight entries. Callahan's Passage has not changed hands, but its casualty totals are climbing sharply, and Dead Lands concentrates on Callahan's Gate. No victor has been declared.
